D.t: Suhas Subramanyam leads by 23.8 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 80,068 votes; a one point swing is about 1,685 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +14.3 and D +32.6. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$583K cash against $54K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
